title: Prepayment Share on Patient Payment Plan Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Desk guidance — extra principal and the returned-payment fee of a Patient Payment Plan**

A prepayment share follows the extra principal the patient has paid: where extra-principal payments received within the last 12 months add up to at least one installment in force, the share is 0.8; where they add up to less but more than zero, the share is 0.9; with none the prepayment share is one. The returned-payment fee is multiplied by the prepayment share.

The extra-principal payments counted are those on the plan whose day received lies fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date. The installment in force is the plan's current monthly installment.

## Input, judgement, result

| Extra principal received within the last 12 months, compared with one installment in force | Prepayment share |
|---|---|
| Equal to it or more | 0.8 |
| More than zero but less | 0.9 |
| None | 1 |

## Hypothetical readings (installment in force 125.00)

- Extra principal of 125.00 within the last 12 months: exactly one installment, share 0.8.
- 124.99: less than one installment, share 0.9.
- 300.00 received 13 months before the handling date and none since: nothing within the period, share one.
